## Checklist before merging

Thank you for your contribution to the repository.
Before submitting this PR, please make sure:

- [ ] `cargo build --release` succeeds without new warnings
- [ ] `cargo fmt` has been run
- [ ] You have tested this against a running server with `pier` installed
- [ ] You have not used code without a license, and added attribution for any third-party code
